verdict.rationale: Medusa maintains machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Admin and Store REST APIs, which back the docs.medusajs.com/api reference. It also documents dedicated Product, Order, Payment and Fulfillment commerce modules, which cover the lifecycle the story describes. The probe's 404s on docs-hosted openapi.json paths do not contradict this, because the specs live in the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of the specific admin endpoints for creating products, editing orders, issuing refunds or triggering fulfillments, and no hands-on or independent confirmation of using the admin API for these tasks.
